metaDescription: Kevin introduces whokilledthescientists.com, a site tracking the missing and dead scientists case with a timeline, connections, and a mind map.
summary: Kevin announces whokilledthescientists.com, a website he built to follow the missing and dead scientists case in real time. He says it lists every scientist, recent developments, connections, organizations, investigative threads, a timeline, and a mind map of connections. It updates automatically twice a day.
